posts.post: Friendly reminder that synthetic fabrics are just plastic bags you’re paying a premium to wear.
You don’t need to be trendy. Just be intentional and people will assume you are wealthy.
Kind of interesting: most people spend more time curating their digital footprint than the actual fabric touching their skin.
The fastest way to change your style is to stop buying clothes for the person you want to be and start dressing for the person you are.
